hooks.command: $j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($j.tool_input.command -notlike '*run_benchmark*') { exit 0 }; $r = 'C:\Projects\LynxMask\benchmark_results\benchmark_report.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $r)) { exit 0 }; $c = Get-Content $r -Raw; $recall = if ($c -match 'RECALL:\s+([\d,.]+)%') { $Matches[1] } else { '?' }; $prec = if ($c -match 'PRECISION:\s+([\d,.]+)%') { $Matches[1] } else { '?' }; $fp = if ($c -match 'False positives:\s+(\d+)') { $Matches[1] } else { '?' }; $clr = if ($c -match 'Krytyczne braki:\s+(\d+)') { $Matches[1] } else { '?' }; Push-Location 'C:\Projects\LynxMask'; git add benchmark_results/; git commit -m "bench: Recall $recall% Precision $prec% FP $fp CLR $clr"; Pop-Location; exit 0
